assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and unexplained syncope, raising concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known sick sinus syndrome.
To correlate these intermittent symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances, a cardiac event monitoring study was ordered for further diagnostic evaluation.
CPT 93271 is the cardiac event monitoring study code.
The service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable under current policy guidelines.
Diagnosis codes I49.5, R42, and R55 support the medical necessity for CPT 93271.
The claim was denied for Cardiac Event Monitoring (CPT 93271).
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-97.
The patient has the right to file an appeal within the timeframe specified in the provider agreement.
Failure to appeal within the designated period may result in the finalization of this denial.
